Sun & Moon series · PR-SM

SM Black Star Promos

Released February 3, 2017 · 250 cards

Expanded

SM Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on February 3, 2017. Its main set has 248 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (250 in total). It includes 247 Pokémon, 4 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

56 illustrators worked on SM Black Star Promos. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (52), Mitsuhiro Arita (14), Shin Nagasawa (14), Naoki Saito (9), kirisAki (8), Kouki Saitou (8), PLANETA Otani (8), 2017 Pikachu Project (7).
